name: Taquería Imperial
notes: Two overhead boards, each photographed multiple times (photos 1/3/4/5 are the same first board at different crops/angles; photo 2 is the second board, also visible in the background of photo 5). The first board carries yellow sticker price updates over some printed prices in photos 1/3/5 that are noticeably higher than the unobstructed prices legible in photo 4 (e.g. Quesadillas $15.99 vs $7.99, Burritos $12.99 vs $7.49); used photo 4's clean, unobstructed prices as canonical since the sticker text was not reliably legible. Fish taco price was illegible in photo 4 (hidden behind a hanging wire) so it was taken from photo 1 instead. All five photos were legible menu boards; nothing skipped.
